arcpy.inspect-script.title: Inspect an ArcPy script
arcpy.inspect-script.summary: Returns the size and SHA-256 of a Python script in the locally configured ArcPy script root without executing it.
examples: Inspect analysis.py and use the returned SHA-256 when requesting approval for arcpy.run-script.

arcpy.run-script.title: Run an approved ArcPy script
arcpy.run-script.summary: Runs a hash-pinned Python script from the locally configured ArcPy script root in the ArcGIS Pro Python environment.
examples: Run analysis.py after obtaining its SHA-256 and approving the exact path, hash, arguments, and workspace revision.

basemap.set.title: Set basemap
basemap.set.summary: Sets a map's basemap using an ArcGIS Pro basemap name.

feature.create.title: Create one feature
feature.create.summary: Creates one point, single-part polyline, or single-part polygon in an editable layer using schema-validated attributes. Coordinates must use the layer spatial reference.

objectId.description: ObjectID from the edit row token; may be null.

globalId.description: GlobalID from the edit row token; may be null.

feature.delete.title: Delete one feature
feature.delete.summary: Deletes exactly one editable-layer feature selected by stable ObjectID or GlobalID. This is deliberately not a where-clause or bulk-delete operation.

feature.layer.describe.title: Describe editable feature layer
feature.layer.describe.summary: Returns the feature layer schema, geometry type, stable identifier fields, and editability needed before a feature edit.

globalIdField.description: GlobalID field name; null when the layer has none.

shapeField.description: Shape field name; null for non-feature-class definitions.

geometryType.description: Shape type name; null for non-feature-class definitions.

spatialReference.description: { wkid, name }; null for non-feature-class definitions.

feature.query.title: Query features by attributes and extent
feature.query.summary: Runs a bounded feature query with a safe where clause and optional layer-coordinate envelope/spatial relationship. Results always include ObjectID and GlobalID when available.

spatialRelationship.description: Spatial relationship name; null without a spatial filter.

items.description: objectId, globalId (null without a GlobalID field), and the requested field values.

feature.select.title: Select bounded features
feature.select.summary: Replaces or adds to a layer selection using a bounded attribute/spatial query. This changes selection only; it does not edit feature data.

feature.update.title: Update one feature's attributes or geometry
feature.update.summary: Updates exactly one feature selected by ObjectID or GlobalID. Attribute names and values are validated against the layer schema; coordinates use the layer spatial reference.

gp.describe.title: Describe geoprocessing tool
gp.describe.summary: Describes one system geoprocessing tool from its toolbox metadata: parameters (data types, required/optional/derived, direction, defaults, domains such as coded values and ranges), the positional signature gp.run expects, environments, attributes and the risk tier with its reasons. Never runs the tool.
examples: Describe analysis.Buffer before building gp.run parameters.

tool.description: Execution name such as 'analysis.Buffer' (the 'Buffer_analysis' form is also accepted).

gp.query.title: Run read-only geoprocessing query
gp.query.summary: Runs one read-only system geoprocessing query tool (management.GetCount, management.GetRasterProperties, management.GetCellValue) without review and returns its result values and messages. Outputs are not added to the map, nothing is overwritten and nothing is written to geoprocessing history. Use gp.run for every other tool.
examples: Run management.GetCount on a layer to count its rows.

parameters.description: Positional values in gp.describe 'signature' order; null or '#' leaves a value unset.

gp.run.title: Run geoprocessing tool
gp.run.summary: Runs an ArcGIS geoprocessing tool by toolbox-qualified name with bounded positional parameters (gp.describe 'signature' order), explicit environments, deterministic history/output flags, and complete result messages and derived values. Always requires review; autonomous mode refuses Destructive and UserCode tools. A dry run statically validates the parameters and reports the risk tier.
examples: Run analysis.Buffer with input, output, and distance parameters.

gp.search.title: Search geoprocessing tools
gp.search.summary: Searches the installed ArcGIS Pro system toolboxes by name, display name, keywords and summary. Returns execution names (alias.ToolName) for gp.describe and gp.run, with each tool's risk tier. Reads toolbox metadata only; never runs a tool.
examples: Search 'buffer' to find analysis.Buffer and its risk tier.

query.description: Words to match; empty lists tools alphabetically.

label.configure.title: Configure labels
label.configure.summary: Enables or disables feature labels and optionally sets the Arcade expression, font family, size, and text color.

layer.add.title: Add layer
layer.add.summary: Adds a dataset, layer file, or service URL to a map and returns its stable layer handle.

layer.list.title: List layers
layer.list.summary: Lists the flattened layer tree for a map with stable handles and appearance state.

elevation.description: { mode, offset, verticalExaggeration } for feature layers; null otherwise.

layer.set-appearance.title: Set layer appearance
layer.set-appearance.summary: Sets visibility and/or transparency for one layer. Transparency is a percentage from 0 to 100.

layer.set-elevation.title: Set layer elevation
layer.set-elevation.summary: Sets how a feature layer is placed vertically in a scene, with optional cartographic offset and vertical exaggeration.

layout.activate.title: Activate layout
layout.activate.summary: Opens or activates a layout view.

layout.add-map-frame.title: Add map frame
layout.add-map-frame.summary: Adds a map frame to a layout at page coordinates measured in inches.

layout.ensure.title: Ensure layout exists
layout.ensure.summary: Returns an existing named layout or creates a page in inches using the requested dimensions.

layout.ensure-surround.title: Add a map surround
layout.ensure-surround.summary: Adds or converges a named legend, north arrow, or scale bar linked to a map frame using ArcGIS default styling.

layout.inspect.title: Inspect layout
layout.inspect.summary: Returns a layout's page dimensions and flattened element geometry, including map-frame bindings and cameras.

mapFrame.description: { map, mapName, camera } for map frames; null otherwise.

layout.list.title: List layouts
layout.list.summary: Lists project layouts and their map frames using stable handles.

map.description: Map handle; null when the frame has no map.

layout.set-frame-extent.title: Frame a layer on a layout
layout.set-frame-extent.summary: Fits a named map frame to a feature layer with optional scale padding and camera heading/pitch overrides.

layout.set-text.title: Set layout text
layout.set-text.summary: Creates or updates a named point-text element on a layout, positioned in page inches with explicit typography and color.
examples: Create a named title at x 0.5, y 8 with Aptos Display SemiBold at 24 points.

map.activate.title: Activate map
map.activate.summary: Opens or activates a map view for a stable map handle or unambiguous name.

map.clear-selection.title: Clear feature selection
map.clear-selection.summary: Clears selected features in a map without editing feature data. Useful before a clean layout export.

map.ensure.title: Ensure map exists
map.ensure.summary: Returns an existing named map or creates it with the requested 2D/3D type and basemap.
examples: Ensure maps named Zoning, Transit, and Buildings exist.

map.list.title: List maps
map.list.summary: Lists every map and scene in the current project with stable handles, view state, type, and layer counts.
examples: List all maps before choosing which one to activate.

metadata.get.title: Get feature-layer metadata
metadata.get.summary: Reads title, summary, description, tags, credits, and use limitations from a feature layer. The response identifies whether metadata is stored by the map layer or supplied by its dataset source.

xml.description: Raw metadata XML when includeXml is true; null otherwise.

metadata.update.title: Update feature-layer metadata
metadata.update.summary: Updates the supported common metadata fields while preserving unrelated metadata XML. If the layer is using dataset-source metadata, the source XML is copied to editable map-layer metadata in the APRX before applying the patch; the dataset item itself is not changed.

project.get.title: Get project
project.get.summary: Returns the current ArcGIS Pro project identity, path, dirty state, and revision.

Name.description: Project name; null when no project is open.

Uri.description: Project path; null when no project is open.

project.open.title: Open project
project.open.summary: Opens an existing ArcGIS Pro .aprx project, replacing the current project. Requires local approval because it discards the current session context. Refuses while the current project has unsaved feature edits or project changes; save them first with project.save.

project.save.title: Save project
project.save.summary: Saves the current ArcGIS Pro project to disk, first saving any pending feature edits. Requires local approval because it persists every pending change: unsaved data edits and the .aprx.

style.search.title: Search project styles
style.search.summary: Searches symbols in referenced project styles without loading the full style catalog into model context.

symbology.set-simple.title: Set simple symbology
symbology.set-simple.summary: Applies a single-symbol renderer appropriate to a point, line, or polygon feature layer.

symbology.set-unique-values.title: Style polygon categories
symbology.set-unique-values.summary: Applies explicitly specified colors and labels to values in one polygon-layer field.

table.query.title: Query feature attributes
table.query.summary: Runs a bounded read-only attribute query against a feature layer and returns plain JSON rows plus schema metadata.

items.description: Field name to plain JSON value.

table.statistics.title: Summarize numeric field
table.statistics.summary: Computes bounded read-only count, null count, minimum, maximum, sum, and mean statistics for one numeric feature-layer field.

minimum.description: Number; null when no non-null value was inspected.

maximum.description: Number; null when no non-null value was inspected.

mean.description: Number; null when no non-null value was inspected.

view.capture.title: Capture map or layout view
view.capture.summary: Captures the active map view or a named layout as PNG visual evidence and returns a resource handle plus semantic context.

resource.description: Resource URI of the stored PNG.
